apps.localizedDescription: An independently maintained iOS/iPadOS fork of NeoStation, with embedded Dolphin, ARMSX2, RPCS3, Dusklight and KartPad runtimes alongside RetroArch and MeloNX integration, JIT workflows and mobile-friendly game and session management.

versions.localizedDescription:
🎮 NeoStation iOS — 0.0.2

JIT compatibility, DolphiniOS improvements and overall stability update.

--- ## ⚡ StikJIT updated NeoStation now integrates **StikJIT 1.9.0**, replacing the previous 1.5.0 integration. The JIT layer has been updated to improve compatibility across: - **iOS 18** - **iOS 26** - **iOS 27** Pairing validation and JIT diagnostics have also been improved to help reduce silent or indefinite loading states. --- ## 🐬 DolphiniOS improvements The embedded Dolphin integration receives several display and runtime improvements: - improved frame pacing - reduced micro-stutter - **120 Hz support** - improved Metal presentation - improved shader handling - cleaner resource handling between game sessions - improved display diagnostics > 120 Hz support improves presentation on compatible devices but does not turn a 30/60 FPS game into a native 120 FPS game. --- ## 📱 Requirements - iPhone or iPad - **iOS 18 or later** - Developer Mode enabled - NeoStation installed as a standalone IPA - compatible JIT configuration when required **LiveContainer is not supported.** --- ## 🎮 Game files NeoStation does not distribute ROMs, ISOs, BIOS files, firmware or copyrighted commercial game assets. Native ports such as **KartPad** and **Dusklight** require data from the user's own legally obtained supported games. --- ## 📦 Release Download **NeoStation.ipa** from the Assets section. **Version:** 0.0.2 **Internal build:** 365 **Source:** f4583c6a3083b8aed358da28b2f8f849256e0e8b Full credits, licenses, source information and checksums are included with the release assets. --- **One app. One library. Multiple systems.**
